title: Sumoylation and desumoylation assays for a chromatin-remodelling complex in vivo and in vitro
protocol: Transfect HeLa cells grown in a 35 mm dish with 0.3 mg of reptin, 0.6 mg of HisMax-SUMO1, and 0.6 mg of Ubc9 plasmids using PolyFect transfection reagents.
Incubate the transfected cells for 36 hours.
Lysate the cells in 500 μl of lysis buffer (150 mM NaCl, 25 mM Tris-HCl at pH 7.8, 0.1% Nonidet P40, and 1 mM EDTA) supplemented with complete protease inhibitor cocktail and 0.2% SDS.
Briefly sonicate the crude extracts for 3 seconds (setting 3, Branson Sonifier 450).
Centrifuge the lysed cells at 13,000 rpm for 30 minutes to clarify the extract.
Incubate the supernatants with 15 ml of Ni-NTA agarose beads (50% slurry) for 2 hours.
Wash the slurry four times with 1 ml of lysis buffer.
Separate proteins by SDS-PAGE.
Confirm the existence of SUMOylated reptin and non-SUMOylated reptin by immunoblotting with anti-reptin IgG or anti-SUMO antibody.
Purify SUMO1, GST-SAE1/2, and His-Ubc9 proteins for the in vitro SUMOylation assay.
Reconstitute human recombinant SUMO protein in a reaction volume of 10 ml.
Add 2 mg of purified SUMO protein to the reaction mixture.
Include 0.3 mg of purified SAE1/2 protein in the reaction mixture.
Add 0.5 mg of purified Ubc9 protein to the reaction mixture.
Mix 0.2 ml of 100 mM ATP into the reaction volume.
Combine with an ATP regenerating system containing 50 mM Tris-HCl at pH 7.6, 5 mM MgCl2, 2 mM ATP, 10 mM creatine phosphate, and 3.5 U/ml creatin kinase.
Add 0.6 U/ml inorganic pyrophosphatase to the reaction mixture.
Include a protease inhibitor cocktail in the reaction volume.
Add 1 ml of 35S-methionine-labelled in vitro-translated reptin protein to the reaction mixture.
Incubate the reaction mixture at 37°C for 3 hours.
Analyze reaction products by autoradiography.
Transfect HeLa cells grown in a 24-well plate with 0.05 mg of reptin plasmid, 0.15 mg of SUMO1 plasmid, and 0.15 mg of Ubc9 plasmid using PolyFect transfection reagents.
Transfect the same HeLa cells with either 0.3 mg of SENP1 or 0.3 mg of SENP1C603A plasmids along with other plasmids using PolyFect transfection reagents.
Incubate transfected HeLa cells for 36 hours post-transfection.
Add 100 μl of sampling buffer containing 25 mM Tris-HCl at pH 6.8, 2% β-mercaptoethanol, 0.8% (w/v) SDS, 0.1% bromophenol blue, and 10% (v/v) glycerol to each well for cell lysis.
Lysate 20 μl of the cell lysates from each well for analysis by SDS-PAGE followed by immunoblotting.
Transfect 293 cells grown in a 100 mm plate with 10 mg of myc-SENP1 or SENP1C603A using calcium phosphate transfection reagents.
Incubate transfected 293 cells for 48 hours post-transfection.

Lysate the cells with 500 μl of cell lysis buffer containing 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA, 25 mM Tris-HCl at pH 7.8, 10% glycerol, and 0.1% Nonidet P-40 along with protease inhibitor cocktail for each well.
Proceed to perform SDS-PAGE followed by immunoblotting analysis of the cell lysates.
Incubate the lysates with anti-myc antibody for 2 hours.
Mix 50 ml of 50% protein A-Sepharose bead slurry with the lysates for an additional hour.
Wash immunoprecipitated materials three times with cell lysis buffer to eliminate non-specific binding.
Incubate washed materials with 5 μl of in vitro SUMOylated reptin at 37°C for 4 hours.
Incubate reaction products at 37°C for 3 hours and analyze by autoradiography.
Transfect HeLa cells with Flag-reptin, Flag-Ubc9, and HisMax-SUMO1 plasmids.
Harvest cells after 48 hours and lyse them with ice-cold PBS containing 0.2% Nonidet P-40 and 1 mM DTT.
Sonicate the lysates for 3 seconds (setting 3, Branson sonifier 450).
Centrifuge the lysates to take the supernatant.
Incubate the supernatant with Ni-NTA agarose resin.
Wash the resins with PBS containing 0.2% Nonidet P-40.
Elute bound materials with 300 mM imidazole.
Dilute eluted SUMOylated reptin with PBS containing 0.2% Nonidet P-40 and 1 mM DTT.
Incubate diluted SUMOylated reptin with anti-Flag M2 antibody-immobilized agarose beads.
Wash the resulting immunoprecipitate with PBS containing 0.2 % Nonidet P-40.
Wash the bound materials three times with buffer containing 20 mM Tris-HCl, pH 7.5, 500 mM NaCl, 0.2 % Nonidet P-40, and 10 % glycerol.
Elute the bound materials with 3X Flag peptide (200 mg/ml) to obtain SUMOylated Flag-tagged reptin proteins.
Transfect HeLa cells with only a Flag-reptin plasmid to prepare unmodified non-SUMOylated reptin protein.
Prepare lysates from transfected cells as described above.
Sonicate the cell lysates for 3 seconds at setting 3 on a Branson sonifier 450.
Incubate the resulting supernatant with anti-Flag M2 antibody-immobilized agarose beads.
Elute Flag-tagged non-SUMOylated reptin as described above.
